referee_caveats_inferred: Extrapolation from 2.5 arcsec to ~2000 au rests on assumed single power laws (rho r^-2, T r^-0.36 or r^0.2) with no resolved test at core scale.
The two protostellar temperature estimates differ by ~19 K and are simply averaged; the average inherits both systematic errors.
Mass uncertainty (20-40%) excludes the dust emissivity uncertainty, which the authors say can be a factor of 5.
Core classification depends on an unpublished outflow survey (Nony et al. in prep.).
Median prestellar temperature is quoted as 23 K in section 6.3.3 and 22 K in the Conclusion.
Free-free correction is not homogeneous across protoclusters.

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Derived products only (catalog tables plus 14 sets of 2.5 arcsec PPMAP maps and 1.3 mm images): roughly a few GB; no raw ALMA visibilities are reprocessed.
reproducibility.score_reason: Equations, constants and exponents are fully given and results are numeric, but the key inputs (PPMAP images, core catalogs, classification) come from other papers and are not restated.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The temperature and mass recipe is closed-form, but it depends on PPMAP images and catalogs from companion papers, and the paper does not state that these are public.
